Remember this plot… ?

weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax, color= name)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5)

#Labels

weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax, color= name)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5)
## Warning: Removed 17 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range
## (`geom_point()`).

labs (
  title = "temperature plot", 
  x= "minimum daily temperature (C)",
  y= "maximum daily temperature (C)",
  caption = "Data from rnoaa package; temperatures in 2017."
)
## <ggplot2::labels> List of 4
##  $ x      : chr "minimum daily temperature (C)"
##  $ y      : chr "maximum daily temperature (C)"
##  $ title  : chr "temperature plot"
##  $ caption: chr "Data from rnoaa package; temperatures in 2017."

#Scales

Start with the same plot

weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = name), alpha = .5) + 
  labs(
    title = "Temperature plot",
    x = "Minimum daily temperature (C)",
    y = "Maxiumum daily temperature (C)",
    color = "Location",
    caption = "Data from the rnoaa package") + 
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(-15, 0, 15), 
    labels = c("-15º C", "0", "15"))
## Warning: Removed 17 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range
## (`geom_point()`).

weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = name), alpha = .5) + 
  labs(
    title = "Temperature plot",
    x = "Minimum daily temperature (C)",
    y = "Maxiumum daily temperature (C)",
    color = "Location",
    caption = "Data from the rnoaa package") + 
scale_color_hue(
  name = "Location", 
  h = c(100, 300))
## Warning: Removed 17 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range
## (`geom_point()`).

weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = name), alpha = .5) + 
  labs(
    title = "Temperature plot",
    x = "Minimum daily temperature (C)",
    y = "Maxiumum daily temperature (C)",
    color = "Location",
    caption = "Data from the rnoaa package") + 
viridis::scale_color_viridis(
  name = "Location", 
  discrete= TRUE
)
## Warning: Removed 17 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range
## (`geom_point()`).

#Themes

weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = name), alpha = .5) + 
  labs(
    title = "Temperature plot",
    x = "Minimum daily temperature (C)",
    y = "Maxiumum daily temperature (C)",
    color = "Location",
    caption = "Data from the rnoaa package") + 
viridis::scale_color_viridis(
  name = "Location", 
  discrete= TRUE) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
## Warning: Removed 17 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range
## (`geom_point()`).

weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = name), alpha = .5) + 
  labs(
    title = "Temperature plot",
    x = "Minimum daily temperature (C)",
    y = "Maxiumum daily temperature (C)",
    color = "Location",
    caption = "Data from the rnoaa package") + 
viridis::scale_color_viridis(
  name = "Location", 
  discrete= TRUE) +
  theme_minimal()
## Warning: Removed 17 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range
## (`geom_point()`).

Do legend theme and legend

weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = name), alpha = .5) + 
  labs(
    title = "Temperature plot",
    x = "Minimum daily temperature (C)",
    y = "Maxiumum daily temperature (C)",
    color = "Location",
    caption = "Data from the rnoaa package") + 
viridis::scale_color_viridis(
  name = "Location", 
  discrete= TRUE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
## Warning: Removed 17 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range
## (`geom_point()`).

## Setting Options

library(tidyverse)

knitr:opts_chunk$set(
  fig>width = 6, 
  fig.asp = 0.6, 
  out.width = "90%"
)

theme_set(theme_minimal() +  theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

options (
  ggplot2.continous.colour= "viridis", 
  ggplot2.continious.fill = "viridis"
)
 scale_colour_discrete = scale_color_viridis_d
 scale_fill_discrete = scale_fill_viridis_d

##Data args in ‘geom’

central_park = 
  weather_df |> 
  filter(name == "CentralPark_NY")

waikiki = 
  weather_df |> 
  filter( name == "waikiki_HA")

ggplot(data = waikiki, aes(x=date, y=tmax, color = name)) +
  geom_point ()+
  geom_line ( data = central_park)

If you want to display summary to create two datasets and include one in geom line
